liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Loser** (1 review): Reviewer names Loser among the musical highlights of the night [20]
- **Johnny B. Goode** (1 review): Jerry's solo tone is unusually clean, fat and rich; reviewer has never heard his guitar sound like this [18]
- **Space (3)** (1 review): Reviewer finds the Space empty [15]
- **The Other One (4)** (1 review): Reviewer says the Other One never takes off, with the band holding back [15]
- **Stella Blue (4)** (1 review): Reviewer recommends the Stella Blue into Brokedown Palace with Ornette Coleman, calling the jazz-and-Jerry blend soulful [14]
- **Turn On YourLovelight (4)** (1 review): Reviewer hears some funk in Lovelight, but says it only digs in near the end [15]

## Setlist highlights

- **More Drums(3)**: back after 198 archived shows (989 days); rare: 4 archived performances [25]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Broken Arrow (1) [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1993-02-23.sbd.unknown.14485.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 170 min; rated 3.17/5 by 6 [1]. Said about its sound: Phil's bass has a loud, bouncy lead tone in this recording [23]
- **gd1993-02-23.116152.NeumannKMF4.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 148 min; rated 3/5 by 5 [2]
- **gd1993-02-23.142895.mtx.tobin.flac1644**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 172 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd93-02-23.sbd.hall.1611.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 168 min; rated 4.04/5 by 23 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer grades the sound an A; Reviewer says the sound and mix are excellent, and the band's enjoyment comes through the line; Reviewer calls the recording snappy and pulsating, very good for its era [14][17][21][24]
- **gd1993-02-23.134784.neumann.fob.jbraveman.flac1648**: audience recording; 18 songs; 172 min [8]. Said about its sound: Set I was recorded hotter than Set II, so its volume was reduced to even things out [8]

## Around the show

- Garcia played a yellow guitar in the second set; reviewer asks for details about it [16]
- The Mardi Gras parade included a huge Bill Clinton float holding a sax and a joint, smoke billowing from his head [19]
- Reviewer enjoyed the Ornette set, though the sound of it was poor [19]
- A winding path was cleared on the floor so parade floats could pass while drummers played; a giant sax-playing Clinton stood out [20]
- Jerry played the guitar called Wolf for the whole show [20]
- The Mardi Gras Parade featured Sikiru and Delgado Coleman [1]
- Ornette Coleman and Graham Wiggins on didgeridoo joined in during the drums segment [1]
- It was a Mardi Gras show, with Ornette Coleman and Primetime opening [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1993-02-23.sbd.unknown.14485.shnf**: source: SBD>DAT(S)>CDR [1]. Also: Reviewer judges this a real DAT soundboard, while the other copy seems to include a cassette generation; Brokedown encore comes from a weaker soundboard; The Brokedown Palace on this soundboard comes from an audience source [1][23]
- **gd1993-02-23.116152.NeumannKMF4.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: taped by Da Weez; transferred by D5scott; source: source: 2 Neumann KMF4 microphones-up front > Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassettes; [2]. Also: This is an audience recording made with Neumann KMF4 microphones, distributed as 16-bit FLAC [2]
- **gd1993-02-23.142895.mtx.tobin.flac1644**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix 2 Source Mix - SBD (shnid = 1611) SBD> DAT> Sonic Solutions (for phase correction)> CD; via Mike Hall + AUD (shnid = 141067) fl1c6/44.1 Source Info: FOB… [3]. Also: Matrix mix of a soundboard and an audience source, made by an archive.org user, in 16-bit FLAC [3]
- **gd93-02-23.sbd.hall.1611.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> DAT> Sonic Solutions (for phase correction)> CD [5]. Also: Reviewer judges this a real DAT soundboard, while the other copy seems to include a cassette generation; Brokedown encore comes from a weaker soundboard [24]
- **gd1993-02-23.134784.neumann.fob.jbraveman.flac1648**: taped by unknown; transferred by jbraveman; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source: Neumann TLM 170 FOB AUD > DAT; [8]. Also: Front-of-board recording with Neumann mics, processed in Goldwave to remove close claps and balloon pops [8]
